decisions.reason: The charting bundle has not been visible since 2018, which weakens the case for it, but as a plugin on the established map.apps platform it still costs little to keep while demand remains uncertain.

The hierarchical search bundle only ever had a brief mention and has not been visible for two years, so the uncertainty has resolved toward low value and its resources are better spent on the core platform.
The GIS software platform is the firm's flagship and strategic direction, a core commitment rather than a marginal option, so withdrawing it is very unlikely.
Mobile field data capture fits the firm's enterprise GIS offer and growing demand for mobile solutions, so despite lower visibility the option still holds value worth preserving.
The search extension sits close to the core offer and costs little to maintain, and its absence from the website is not yet enough evidence of poor value to justify abandoning it.
